footer.info: Iwon Naildisplay creates smart magnetic display systems designed to elevate nail color presentation in modern salons.

header.title: Professional
header.subtitle: Showcase your shades with clarity and elegance. Our smart display system helps you present, organize, and sell more effectively.

products.title: The Best Way to
products.subtitle: A modular nail display system designed for both everyday use and professional salons-helping to organize, showcase, and simplify color selection with ease.
products.displaySub: Present nail colors clearly and professionally

choice.title: Designed for
choice.subtitle: Place the removable sample nail directly on your finger to see how the color or design will look in real life. This simple testing method makes it easier to compare shades and confidently choose the perfect one.

options.title: Three Display Options. One Smart System.
options.subtitle: Select the configuration that fits your needs-a storage cabinet for full organization or a versatile frame for flexible presentation.
options.frameSub: A minimal display solution with stand or wall-mount option.
options.cabinetSub: Integrated storage and display in one elegant unit.
options.displaySub: A minimal display solution with stand or wall-mount option.

organization.title: Smart Color Organization
organization.subtitle: A clear numbering system connects each sample nail with its matching polish bottle, helping quickly locate, organize and present every color with ease.

upgrade.title: Upgrade Your Salon Display Today
upgrade.subtitle: Discover a smarter, cleaner and more elegant way to present colors, designed for both everyday users and nail professionals.

products.title: Build Your Perfect Display Setup
products.subtitle: Discover all components of the Iwon Nail Display system designed to organize, present and elevate your nail color collection.

description.nails: IND Nails are removable tips designed for the professional display of nail colors and nail art. They can be placed directly on the finger, allowing for a realistic assessment of the color against the hand. They offer an innovative and versatile display solution.
description.display: The IND Display Strip is a minimalist display unit featuring double-sided adhesive tape-suitable for almost any shelving unit in the beauty and nail styling industries.
description.magnetic: IND Magnetic Nails are removable tips designed for the professional presentation of nail polish colors and nail art. These tips can be tried on directly on the finger, allowing for a realistic visualization of the color on the hand. When combined with the IND Frame Display, IND Cabinet Display, and IND Displaybar, they form an innovative and versatile display solution. Minimum order quantity: 10 pieces.
description.transparent: IND Transparent Nail Tips are removable swatches designed for the professional presentation of nail polish colors and nail art. They can be tried on directly, allowing for a realistic visualization of the color on the hand. When paired with the IND display rail, they offer an innovative and versatile display solution.
description.frame: IND Frame Display is a modern, framed display designed for the elegant presentation of nail colors and designs. Ideal for beauty salons and retail stores, it helps organize your collection while ensuring a clear, attractive display. It can be wall-mounted or used as a freestanding unit, offering a stylish and professional look.
description.cabinet: IND Cabinet Display combines elegant presentation with practical storage. Its exterior resembles a classic framed display, while the interior features shelves for organizing nail accessories. The cabinet opens for easy access to its contents and can be placed on a countertop or mounted on the wall.

blocks.text: Protecting your personal data is important to us. This privacy policy explains which personal data we process when you visit our website www.iwonnaildisplay.de and use our ordering and communication options.
Personal data means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.
We process your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, in particular the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
The controller responsible for processing data on this website is:
The controller is the natural or legal person who determines the purposes and means of processing personal data.

sections.title: 3. Hosting and technical provision of the website

blocks.text: 3.1 Hosting by Vercel
Our website is provided through the Vercel hosting platform.
Provider: Vercel Inc., USA.
When you visit our website, technically necessary data may be processed, in particular:

items: Date and time of the request

blocks.text: This processing serves to provide our website securely, reliably and without technical faults.
The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is to provide a secure and functional website and to identify technical disruptions and abusive access.
3.2 Cloudflare
Where Cloudflare is used to deliver or protect our website, technical connection data, in particular IP addresses and request information, may be processed.
In this case, processing serves the technical provision and security of the website and protection against abusive access.
The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
When you place an order through our website, we process the data you provide to the extent necessary to handle and fulfil your order.
This may include:

items: Voluntary messages in the comments field

blocks.text: We use this data in particular for:

items: Fulfilling statutory documentation and retention obligations

blocks.text: The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR, where processing is necessary to perform a contract or take steps prior to entering into a contract.
Where we process data due to statutory retention or record-keeping obligations, the legal basis is Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.
Voluntary information is used only to the extent necessary to deal with the matter concerned.
We currently offer payment by bank transfer.
After placing an order, you will receive the information required for payment by email.
As part of payment processing, we process the data necessary to match and verify incoming payments, to the extent that this data is provided to us by the bank or in connection with the order.
This may include, in particular, the name, payment amount, payment reference and payment date.
The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR and, where statutory obligations apply, Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.
We use the shipping service provider DHL to deliver ordered goods.
Where necessary for shipping, we share the required personal data with the shipping service provider, in particular:

items: Other information required for delivery, where applicable

blocks.text: An email address or phone number is shared for shipping notifications only where an appropriate legal basis exists.
The legal basis for sharing data necessary for delivery is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
We use the Resend service to send automated order confirmations and other transactional emails.
Provider: Plus Five Five, Inc., USA (Resend).
When this service is used, the following personal data may be processed in particular:

items: Name, if included in the message

blocks.text: Processing serves to confirm orders, provide information about order fulfilment and ensure communication with our customers.
The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR, where communication is necessary to perform the contract.
In other cases, processing to ensure reliable business communication may be based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
When you contact us by email, we process the personal data you provide, such as your name, email address and the content of your message.
We use this data exclusively to deal with your enquiry and, where applicable, to perform a contract.
Where your enquiry relates to a contract or steps prior to entering into a contract, processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
In other cases, processing is based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is to respond appropriately to incoming enquiries.
The data is deleted once it is no longer needed to deal with the enquiry, provided that no statutory retention obligations or legitimate grounds for further storage apply.
In the future, our website is intended to provide electronic options for submitting withdrawal declarations and product complaints.
When dealing with such requests, we may process, in particular, names, email addresses, details of the contract or product concerned and information provided voluntarily.
The purpose of processing is to receive, review and deal with the declaration or request and to fulfil statutory and contractual obligations.
Possible legal bases include, in particular, Article 6(1)(b) and (c) GDPR.
Our website may use technically necessary storage and access technologies where these are required to provide expressly requested functions, such as the shopping cart.

Where such technologies are strictly necessary, their permissibility is governed by Section 25(2) TDDDG (German Telecommunications Digital Services Data Protection Act). Any associated processing of personal data is carried out on the relevant legal basis under the GDPR.
To the best of our current knowledge, we do not use services such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel to analyse website visitors or track them for advertising purposes.
If technologies requiring consent are used in the future, they will generally only be activated once the required consent has been given, and this privacy policy will be updated accordingly.
In operating our website and fulfilling orders, personal data may be shared with the following recipients or categories of recipients where necessary and legally permissible:

items: Banks and parties involved in payment processing
Tax advisers and other recipients required by law, where applicable

blocks.text: Personal data is not shared for independent third-party advertising purposes on the basis of the order processing described here.

sections.title: 12. Transfers of personal data to third countries

blocks.text: The use of certain technical service providers, in particular Vercel and Resend, may involve processing or transferring personal data outside the European Union or the European Economic Area.
Such processing must meet the requirements of Article 44 et seq. GDPR.

Depending on the provider and the specific processing, the relevant basis may include an applicable adequacy decision by the European Commission or appropriate safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses.
We store personal data only for as long as necessary for the respective processing purposes or where statutory retention obligations apply.

Order and contract data is generally retained for the duration of contract performance and beyond that only where necessary to fulfil statutory obligations, assert or defend claims or serve other lawful purposes.
Statutory retention periods may apply to certain tax-related documents and invoices. Depending on the type of document, these may be, for example, six, eight or ten years.
Personal data that is no longer required is deleted or, where possible, anonymised, unless there are lawful grounds for further storage.
Under the applicable legal provisions, you have the following rights in particular:

items.label: Access (Article 15 GDPR):
items.text: You may request information about the processing of your personal data.

items.label: Rectification (Article 16 GDPR):
items.text: You may request the correction of inaccurate data.

items.label: Erasure (Article 17 GDPR):
items.text: You may request the deletion of your personal data where the statutory conditions are met.

items.label: Restriction of processing (Article 18 GDPR):
items.text: You may request the restriction of processing under certain conditions.

items.label: Data portability (Article 20 GDPR):
items.text: Where the statutory conditions are met, you may receive your data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

items.label: Objection (Article 21 GDPR):
items.text: You may object to the processing of your personal data where the statutory conditions are met.

items.label: Withdrawal of consent (Article 7(3) GDPR):
items.text: You may withdraw consent you have given at any time with effect for the future.

blocks.text: You may contact us at any time to exercise your rights:
Iwon@iwonnaildisplay.de

sections.title: 15. Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

blocks.text: Under Article 77 GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority if you consider that the processing of your personal data infringes the GDPR.
For our business in North Rhine-Westphalia, the following supervisory authority is particularly relevant:
State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information North Rhine-Westphalia (Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit Nordrhein-Westfalen, LDI NRW)
https://www.ldi.nrw.de/
blocks.label: Website

blocks.text: Your right to lodge a complaint with another competent data protection supervisory authority remains unaffected.
The information necessary to process and fulfil an order is required so that we can accept and fulfil your order.
Without the required data, it may not be possible to process or fulfil the order.
Voluntary information is marked accordingly.
To the best of our current knowledge, no automated decision-making, including profiling within the meaning of Article 22 GDPR, takes place in connection with the order processing described here.
We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse and unlawful processing.
Data transmission through our website is generally encrypted using HTTPS.
Please note that communication over the internet may involve security risks despite technical safeguards.
We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy if legal requirements, the technical systems we use or our data processing procedures change.
The version published on our website at the relevant time applies.
Consumers have the right to withdraw from a purchase contract concluded through our online shop within 14 days without giving any reason.
The withdrawal period is 14 days from the day on which you or a person designated by you, other than the carrier, takes possession of the ordered goods.
To exercise your right of withdrawal, you must inform us of your decision to withdraw from the contract by means of a clear statement.
You may inform us of your withdrawal, for example, by email or letter.
You may use the model withdrawal form below for this purpose. However, using this form is not mandatory.
To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient to send your withdrawal statement before the 14-day period expires.
You may also withdraw from your contract using our electronic withdrawal function.
Withdraw from the contract
This function allows you to identify the relevant order and confirm your withdrawal electronically.

After submission, you will receive an acknowledgement of receipt without delay on a durable medium, usually by email. This includes the content of your withdrawal statement and the date and time it was received.
Using the electronic withdrawal function is voluntary. You may still exercise your right of withdrawal by email or letter.
If you withdraw from this contract, we will reimburse all payments we have received from you, including the cost of our least expensive standard delivery option.
Additional delivery costs arising from your choice of a delivery option other than our least expensive standard delivery option will not be reimbursed.
Reimbursement will be made without undue delay and no later than 14 days from the day on which we receive your withdrawal statement.
We will generally use the same means of payment that you used for the original payment, unless expressly agreed otherwise with you.
You will not incur any additional fees for the reimbursement.
We may withhold reimbursement until we have received the goods back or you have supplied evidence of having sent them back, whichever is earlier.
You must send back or hand over the goods without undue delay and no later than 14 days from the day on which you informed us of your withdrawal, to the following address:
The return deadline is met if you send the goods before the 14-day period expires.
Cost of returning the goods
You bear the direct cost of returning the goods.

Please note that this provision concerns ordinary return costs when exercising a statutory right of withdrawal. Your statutory rights in the event of faulty or incorrectly delivered goods remain unaffected.
Diminished value of the goods
You are only liable for any diminished value of the goods resulting from handling beyond what is necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning.

complaints.title: Complaints & Statutory Warranty
intro: We place great importance on the quality of our products and the satisfaction of our customers. If a product arrives damaged, faulty or not as agreed, we will be happy to help.
This page explains how to submit a complaint and the statutory rights available to you.

sections.title: 1. When can you submit a complaint?

blocks.text: You may contact us if, for example:

items: an item has a material or manufacturing defect,
a product does not have the agreed characteristics,
a delivered product does not function properly.

blocks.text: Whether a statutory defect exists and which claims are available is determined by the applicable legal provisions.

sections.title: 2. How can you submit a complaint?

blocks.text: Please contact us by email:
The following information will help us deal with your enquiry as quickly as possible:

items: The name of the product concerned
A brief description of the problem
If possible, photos of the damaged or faulty product

blocks.text: An order number is required when submitting a complaint through the form. Photos help us assess the issue, but they are not a mandatory requirement for exercising your statutory rights in respect of defects.
You can also reach us by phone:
Electronic complaints form
In the future, we will also provide an electronic complaints form on our website.
Until then, you can submit your complaint to us by email at any time.
Once we receive your complaint, we will review the circumstances you describe and contact you to agree on the next steps.
Depending on the nature of the defect, additional information or access to the product concerned may be required for assessment.
Where possible, please contact us before returning a product so that we can coordinate the process with you.
Your statutory rights remain in place even if you submit a complaint without contacting us beforehand.
Our products are covered by the statutory rights in respect of defects under the German Civil Code (BGB).
Where a product is defective, consumers are generally entitled to have the defect remedied.
Subject to the applicable legal provisions, they may choose between the following options:

items.label: Repair:
items.text: Remedying the defect, for example by repairing the product.

items.label: Replacement:
items.text: Delivery of a product free from defects.

blocks.text: The statutory requirements and limits applicable to each type of remedy remain unaffected.
Where the statutory conditions are met, the following rights may also be available in particular:

items: Compensation for damages or reimbursement of wasted expenditure

blocks.text: The purchase price will be refunded where the statutory conditions for doing so are met.
For new goods, the statutory limitation period for claims relating to defects is generally two years from delivery of the goods.
Consumer purchases are subject to statutory protective provisions, including the special rules on the burden of proof.

If, in a consumer purchase, a defective condition covered by the statutory provisions becomes apparent within one year after the transfer of risk, the statutory presumptions under Section 477 BGB apply.
Contracts with business customers (B2B) are subject to the relevant statutory provisions and any validly agreed contractual terms.
This information does not restrict statutory warranty rights.
Where a defect exists and there is a statutory entitlement to a remedy, we bear the necessary expenses in accordance with Section 439(2) BGB.
These include, in particular, the necessary:
If returning the product is necessary to provide a remedy, we will be happy to agree on the procedure with you in advance.
Please contact us at:
You will not incur additional costs for a remedy required by law to the extent provided for by the statutory provisions.
If your order arrives visibly damaged or contains the wrong item, please inform us as soon as reasonably possible.
A brief description and, where possible, photos of the packaging and the product concerned are helpful.
However, immediate notification is not a requirement for consumers to exercise their statutory rights in respect of defects.

sections.title: 8. Difference between a complaint and withdrawal

blocks.text: Please note that a complaint about a defective product and the statutory withdrawal from a distance contract are different rights.
You exercise statutory rights because a product is defective or does not have the agreed characteristics.
blocks.label: Complaint:

blocks.text: Under the statutory right of withdrawal, consumers can generally withdraw from a purchase contract concluded online within 14 days without giving any reason.
blocks.label: Withdrawal:

blocks.text: Further information about withdrawal can be found in our separate withdrawal notice.
Please use these contact details for complaints and to arrange any necessary return.
We sell our products to both consumers and business customers.
Orders placed by business customers are subject to the relevant statutory provisions and, where applicable, validly agreed contractual terms.

In particular, where a transaction is commercial for both parties, the statutory duties to inspect goods and notify defects under Section 377 of the German Commercial Code (HGB) may apply, provided that the relevant conditions are met.
These provisions do not restrict the rights of consumers.

faqItems.title: Can the magnetic nails be reused?
faqItems.answer: The magnetic nails can be reused; however, this is not recommended. Additional nails can be ordered at any time. Please feel free to contact us!

faqItems.title: What should I pay particular attention to when using the magnetic nails?
faqItems.answer: The magnetic nails are made of durable material. However, please note that improper use may result in injury.

faqItems.title: Is it possible to order a free sample?
faqItems.answer: Unfortunately, we are currently unable to offer free samples.

faqItems.title: What are the shipping costs?
faqItems.answer: Germany: €4.90 including VAT, free for product orders of €50 or more including VAT (up to 30 kg). Poland and other EU countries except Germany, plus Monaco: up to 2 kg – €11.99, up to 5 kg – €20.49, up to 10 kg – €25.49, up to 20 kg – €31.49, up to 30 kg – €48.49. Switzerland: up to 2 kg – €16.99, up to 5 kg – €29.99, up to 10 kg – €37.99, up to 20 kg – €51.99, up to 30 kg – €65.99. Other supported European countries: up to 2 kg – €19.99, up to 5 kg – €32.99, up to 10 kg – €40.99, up to 20 kg – €55.99, up to 30 kg – €70.99. United Arab Emirates and Qatar: up to 2 kg – €22.99, up to 5 kg – €48.99, up to 10 kg – €64.99, up to 20 kg – €103.99, up to 30 kg – €144.99. These are final shipping prices; any import charges are not included. Orders exceeding the weight limit require email contact. All orders to the United Kingdom, including Northern Ireland, are handled exclusively by email. Deliveries to countries not listed in the form require an individual quote. Please contact us directly: Iwon@iwonnaildisplay.de.

faqItems.title: Are there any variations from the product description?
faqItems.answer: Each display is carefully handcrafted and unique. Therefore, minor variations may occur, such as slight differences in color shade or small gaps.

faqItems.title: Are the display frames and cabinets available in other colors?
faqItems.answer: At the moment, we can only offer the color "white". We are currently working on a solution that will allow for individual color customization of the frames and cabinets.

faqItems.title: Hygiene instructions
faqItems.answer: To ensure optimal hygiene, please wash and disinfect your hands thoroughly before trying on the magnetic nails.
